Horrible parenting.|audio = BathroomApproachWave 7 2.ogg|[[Dispatcher]] on Wave 7 (Formerly,[[Bathroom Approach]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Mother Ducky''' was an enemy that appeared in [[Bathroom Approach]] as part of the [[Ducky Revenge Event]] and its rerun in the [[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]]. It has a decent amount of health and average speed. Upon death, the '''Mother Ducky''' spawns multiple eggrolls. These can be the [[Eggroll 1]], [[Eggroll 2]] and [[Eggroll 3]], which upon death spawn a [[Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Ducky]]. ==Logbook Description== "''Mother Ducky is the heart and soul of the Duck Army, keeping everyone in line with her firm but loving approach. She takes special pride in mentoring younger ducks, teaching them important life lessons and filling their hearts with ambition with her stories. All ducks, both big and small, find comfort beneath her nurturing wings.''" ==Appearance== The '''Mother Ducky''' is a yellow duck with orange feet and beak. It wears a pink kimono with bathrobes around its head and white with polka dots ribbon on its tail. It has multiple eggrolls on its body, which fall onto the path once the '''Mother Ducky''' is defeated. It has three animations that it can randomly have, where all three also have differently shaped eyes. The first animation has it have a happy expression, the second has it have a serious expression while the third one has its eyes closed, likely because it is scared. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Bathroom Approach]] is listed instead. *As the '''Mother Ducky''' summons three eggrolls upon death, making it a quite dangerous enemy. **Area of effect towers, like the [[Mortar]], [[Pyromancer]] or [[Rocketeer]] can be useful at killing all the eggrolls summoned at once. **Single target towers like the [[Pursuit]], [[Golden Crook Boss]], [[Turret]] or [[Golden Minigunner]] can also be helpful. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1MotherDucky1.png|Green variant, current version, first animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker1MotherDucky2.png|Green variant, current version, second animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker1MotherDucky3.png|Green variant, current version, third animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseMotherDucky.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (16 April 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Ducky Revenge Trailer -
